SARAH.C: Quick heads-up — SI Launchpad kickoff with CloudPartner + GigaChip next Tue 3pm PT. Goal: onboarding playbook, hands-on labs, and joint announce checklist. Need owners for training, marketplace listing, and perf baseline.
MIKE_L: I can own hands-on labs. Will spin up a sandbox repo and adapt the bootcamp labs. ETA Wed.
EMILY: Propose two certification tracks: 'Marketplace Integrator' (listing, billing, SSO) and 'Infra Integrator' (VPC/private, KMS, on-prem). Each needs a 2hr exam + lab.
DAN: GigaChip wants a co-announcement but requires validated perf on their A100-like SKU. We'll need Dedicated runs and perf report (latency + throughput + cost/1M tokens).
ALEX_OPS: @ENG-SRE-BOT can you schedule a perf sweep? Prefer infra w/ Dedicated x2, batch policy default. I can provide model pins.
JEN_P: I’ll own partner comms and legal gating. Need a one-pager, joint timeline, and approvals checklist. @SARAH.C send draft.
MIKE_L: draft lab plan here: https://console.redwood.ai/si/labs-drafts
SARAH.C: Owners: Training=MIKE_L, Certs=EMILY, HW perf=DAN, Comms=JEN_P. Target deliverables by next Fri.
ENG-SRE-BOT: perf-run job queued: job/11234 — eta 48h
EMILY: for exams, suggest multiple choice (30 q) + 2 practical tasks. Need scoring rubric.
SARAH.C: agree. Also recommend internal enablement session for sales+SEs next week. @MIKE_L can you prep 45-min deck?
MIKE_L: will do. draft by Thu EOD. :thumbsup:
JEN_P: I'll draft a partner one-pager template and share in #sales-enablement.
DAN: FYI: GigaChip legal requested a copy of the one-pager before PR. keep internal.
SARAH.C: noted. thanks all — will follow up with calendar invites + milestone tracker. /cc @ENG-SRE-BOT
